# Insertion

Normative module examples, pinned upstream inputs, and ownership boundaries.

```````````````````````````````` example
This is ++inserted++ text.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="This is " children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:9..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="inserted" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:21..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" text." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
++**b**++ ++c *d*++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Insertion scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Strong scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:10..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Insertion scope=1:11..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
        ├── Text scope=1:13..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c " children=0
        └── Emphasis scope=1:15..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=1:16..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
a++b++c
.
Document scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:2..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
++++text++++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Insertion scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Insertion scope=1:3..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=1:5..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
+++text+++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="+" children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:2..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:4..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:10..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="+" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
++++ a++++b + not ++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++++ a++++b + not ++" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
**++text**++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Strong scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++text" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:11..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
\++a++ ++a\++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++a++ ++a++" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
++a
b++
.
Document scope=1:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Insertion scope=1:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
        ├── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
        ├── SoftBreak scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
        └── Text scope=2:1..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[++link++](/u)
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Link scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("/u") title=null children=1
        └── Insertion scope=1:2..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=1:4..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="link" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
`++a++` <b>++c++</b>
.
Document scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Code scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++a++" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── HTML scope=1:9..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<b>" children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:12..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:14..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
    └── HTML scope=1:17..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="</b>" children=0
````````````````````````````````

upstream-02

```````````````````````````````` example

    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x " children=0
    └── Insertion scope=1:3..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=2

        │   └── Text scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
        └── Text scope=1:12..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" bar" children=0
````````````````````````````````

upstream-06

```````````````````````````````` example
**++test**++

++**test++**
.
Document scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Strong scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++test" children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:11..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Insertion scope=3:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="**test" children=0
    └── Text scope=3:11..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="**" children=0
````````````````````````````````

upstream-07

```````````````````````````````` example
[++link]()++
++[link++]()
.

└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++link" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:11..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
    └── Link scope=2:3..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=2:4..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="link++" children=0
````````````````````````````````

upstream-12

```````````````````````````````` example
++test
++

++
test++

++
test
++
.
Document scope=1:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++test" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=2:1..2:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=4:1..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=4:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=4:3..4:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=5:1..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="test++" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=7:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=7:1..7:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=7:3..7:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=8:1..8:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="test" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=8:5..8:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=9:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++" children=0
````````````````````````````````

upstream-13

```````````````````````````````` example
x ++a ++foo+++++++++++bar++ b++

x ++a ++foo++++++++++++bar++ b++
.
Document scope=1:1..3:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:31 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x " children=0
│   ├── Insertion scope=1:3..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │   ├── Text scope=1:5..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
│   │   └── Insertion scope=1:7..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=1:9..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:16..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="+++" children=0
│   └── Insertion scope=1:19..1:31 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│       ├── Insertion scope=1:21..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=1:23..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bar" children=0
│       └── Text scope=1:28..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x " children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=3:3..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │   ├── Text scope=3:5..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    │   └── Insertion scope=3:7..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=3:9..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:16..3:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="++++" children=0
    └── Insertion scope=3:20..3:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
        ├── Insertion scope=3:22..3:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        │   └── Text scope=3:24..3:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bar" children=0
        └── Text scope=3:29..3:30 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

unicode-flanking

```````````````````````````````` example
中++文++字 ++é，🙂++ a++“b”++ ++中 ++ ++ x++
.

└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:59 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="中" children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:4..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:6..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="文" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:11..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="字 " children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:15..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:17..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="é，🙂" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:28..1:41 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" a++“b”++ " children=0
    └── Insertion scope=1:42..1:59 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:44..1:57 anchor=null attributes={} literal="中 ++ ++ x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

punctuation

```````````````````````````````` example
(++x++) a++!++b ++!++ ++ x++ ++x ++
.
Document scope=1:1..1:35 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:35 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="(" children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:2..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:7..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal=") a++!" children=0
    ├── Insertion scope=1:13..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │   ├── Text scope=1:15..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b " children=0
    │   ├── Insertion scope=1:17..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   │   └── Text scope=1:19..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="!" children=0
    │   └── Text scope=1:22..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" ++ x" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:29..1:35 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" ++x ++" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
    │   └── Text scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0

    │   └── Text scope=1:19..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:22..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0

    │   └── Text scope=1:25..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
````````````````````````````````

nested-strike

```````````````````````````````` example
++~~a~~++ ~~++b++~~
.
````````````````````````````````
